description: This file defines the EntityDateFilterCondition class, which implements date-range filtering logic for data entities within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to construct SQL conditions based on date ranges, such as filtering currently valid rows or rows valid at a specific timestamp. The class also supports date range querying with comprehensive validity scenarios.
